rules: Tags are earned by skipping a Small or Big Blind; each such blind shows its tag in advance.
Each tag is equally likely among the tags allowed at the current ante (min_ante). At ante 1 only 15 of the 24 are possible.
Duplicates are allowed (also within an ante). Held tags trigger oldest first.
Unlock-gated (profile) tags: Rare Tag needs Blueprint discovered; Negative/Foil/Holographic/Polychrome tags need their edition discovered. A simulator can assume all unlocked.
Other tag sources: Anaglyph Deck (Double Tag after each boss), Diet Cola (Double Tag when sold).

tags.name: Uncommon Tag
tags.effect: Next shop: one card slot holds a free Uncommon joker.

tags.name: Rare Tag
tags.effect: Next shop: one card slot holds a free Rare joker.

tags.name: Negative Tag
tags.effect: The next edition-less joker shown in a shop becomes Negative and free.
tags.triggers: next shop with an edition-less joker (stored until then)

tags.name: Foil Tag
tags.effect: The next edition-less joker shown in a shop becomes Foil and free.
tags.triggers: next shop with an edition-less joker

tags.name: Holographic Tag
tags.effect: The next edition-less joker shown in a shop becomes Holographic and free.
tags.triggers: next shop with an edition-less joker

tags.name: Polychrome Tag
tags.effect: The next edition-less joker shown in a shop becomes Polychrome and free.
tags.triggers: next shop with an edition-less joker

tags.name: Investment Tag
tags.effect: Gain $25 after the next Boss Blind is defeated (paid at cash-out; stacks; paid even if saved by Mr. Bones).

tags.name: Voucher Tag
tags.effect: Adds one extra voucher to the next shop (that shop only).

tags.name: Boss Tag
tags.effect: Rerolls the upcoming Boss Blind.

tags.name: Standard Tag
tags.effect: Opens a free Mega Standard Pack.

tags.name: Charm Tag
tags.effect: Opens a free Mega Arcana Pack.

tags.name: Meteor Tag
tags.effect: Opens a free Mega Celestial Pack.

tags.name: Buffoon Tag
tags.effect: Opens a free Mega Buffoon Pack.

tags.name: Handy Tag
tags.effect: Gain $1 for every hand played so far this run.

tags.name: Garbage Tag
tags.effect: Gain $1 for every discard left unused so far this run.

tags.name: Ethereal Tag
tags.effect: Opens a free (normal) Spectral Pack: choose 1 of 2.

tags.name: Coupon Tag
tags.effect: In the next shop, the initially stocked cards and booster packs cost $0 (vouchers and rerolled cards keep normal prices).

tags.name: Double Tag
tags.effect: Gives a copy of the next tag you obtain (Double Tag itself excluded).

tags.name: Juggle Tag
tags.effect: +3 hand size for the next round only (multiple stack).

tags.name: D6 Tag
tags.effect: Rerolls in the next shop start at $0 (then rise by $1 per reroll as usual).

tags.name: Top-up Tag
tags.effect: Create up to 2 Common jokers (limited by free joker slots; no stickers).

tags.name: Speed Tag
tags.effect: Gain $5 for every blind skipped this run (this skip included).

tags.name: Orbital Tag
tags.effect: Level up one random poker hand by 3 (hand fixed and shown when the tag is offered; secret hands only if already played).

tags.name: Economy Tag
tags.effect: Double your money, adding at most $40 (gain = min(money, 40); nothing if money <= 0).
